description:
All electric. Never static. The new Mongoose React E2 Kids Electric Scooter is lightweight, ultra-quiet, and ready to cruise any sidewalk. The high-torque, belt drive motor tops out at 10 miles per hour, and can travel over 8 miles on a single charge. So whether you’re a scooter afficionado or a total n00b, a Mongoose e-scooter is sure to be your youngin's favorite new set of wheels. Your Ride Electrified.
Rider Profile: Designed for optimal neighborhood cruising for riders ages 8 and up, with a maximum weight limit of 120 pounds.
Motor and Throttle: Ultra-quiet kick-start belt drive motor tops out at 10 MPH. To get up to speed, kick start the scooter and use the push button throttle to accelerate.
Battery and Charging: Powered by a long-lasting 12-volt lead acid battery, the React E2 can travel up to 8.5 miles on a single charge. Charger included.
Wheels and Brakes: Durable 145 mm urethane wheels offer a stable ride while the rear foot brake disengages the motor to make stopping safe and simple.
Frame and Coasting: Its lightweight aluminum frame makes it easy to transport and the kickstand makes it easy to store. When the battery runs out, the React E2 converts into a kick scooter for resistance-free riding.
